newsAll.head: Jayden Daniels: Expected back within three weeks
newsAll.body: Daniels (elbow) is expected to return to action for the Commanders in "three weeks or sooner," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

newsAll.head: Keon Coleman: On track to play Week 3
newsAll.body: Coleman (ankle), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers, is expected to play, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

newsAll.head: Caleb Williams: May miss multiple games with Grade 2 strain
newsAll.body: Williams, who is ruled out for Monday's game against the Eagles, has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 hamstring strain, which doctors consider a 3-to-4-week injury, Adam Schefter and Ian Rapoport of ESPN report.

newsAll.head: Tyjae Spears: Uncertain about active status
newsAll.body: Spears (ankle), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Giants, will be monitored pregame, but the Titans are hopeful he'll be able to play, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
